tasks.answer: Use DeleteDiscussion, a destructive confirmation control for deleting a discussion; pass the discussion id.
The login form uses Input, bound to react-hook-form via its required registration prop (e.g. registration={register('email')}); it must render inside Form, with label/error supplied by FieldWrapper.
The discussions table paginates with TablePagination; it needs totalPages, currentPage and rootUrl, building hrefs from the root URL and page number.
MDPreview safely renders Markdown as sanitized HTML; the Markdown body is passed through the required value prop.
CreateDiscussion is an admin-only drawer form for creating a discussion (title + Markdown body); it requires admin permission and has no required props.

notes: One search per task (5 searches); a single get (ui.form.Input) after the task-2 search to confirm the react-hook-form binding constraint. No project/catalog source files read. Budget held: 6 calls total, one get, no repeated IDs.
